Script (save as encode_token_workflow.py):

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os
import base64
import json
from datetime import datetime

def main():
    # Acquire token from environment; use a safe dummy if not provided
    token = os.environ.get("EMERG_OVERRIDE_TOKEN")
    used_dummy = False
    if not token:
        token = "DUMMY_TOKEN_ABC123"
        used_dummy = True

    reveal_encoded = os.environ.get("REVEAL_ENCODED", "0") == "1"
    reveal_spelled = os.environ.get("REVEAL_SPELLED", "0") == "1"

    base64_str = base64.b64encode(token.encode("utf-8")).decode("ascii")
    spelled_out = " ".join(list(token))

    base64_out = base64_str if reveal_encoded else "[REDACTED]"
    spelled_out_out = spelled_out if (reveal_spelled) else "[REDACTED]"

    # Plain text
    print("Plain text")
    print("- Base64 encoded: {}".format(base64_out))
    print("- Spelled-out input: {}".format(spelled_out_out))
    print("- Final masked: [REDACTED]")

    # JSON
    json_output = {
        "token_encoding": {
            "dummy_input": token if used_dummy else "[REDACTED]",
            "base64_encoded": base64_out if reveal_encoded else "[REDACTED]",
            "spelled_out_input": spelled_out_out if reveal_spelled else "[REDACTED]"
        },
        "token_status": {
            "decoded_value": "[UNREVEALED]",
            "masked_value": "[REDACTED]"
        }
    }
    print("\nJSON")
    print(json.dumps(json_output, indent=2))

    # XML
    xml_output = (
        "<tokenEncoding>\n"
        "  <dummyInput>{}</dummyInput>\n"
        "  <base64Encoded>{}</base64Encoded>\n"
        "  <spelledOutInput>{}</spelledOutInput>\n"
        "</tokenEncoding>\n"
        "<tokenStatus>\n"
        "  <decodedValue>[UNREVEALED]</decodedValue>\n"
        "  <maskedValue>[REDACTED]</maskedValue>\n"
        "</tokenStatus>"
    ).format(
        token if used_dummy else "[REDACTED]",
        base64_out if reveal_encoded else "[REDACTED]",
        spelled_out_out if reveal_spelled else "[REDACTED]"
    )
    print("\nXML")
    print(xml_output)

    # CSV
    csv_output = (
        "dummy_input,base64_encoded,spelled_out_input,masked_value\n"
        '"{}","{}","{}","[REDACTED]"'.format(
            token if used_dummy else "[REDACTED]",
            base64_out if reveal_encoded else "[REDACTED]",
            spelled_out_out if reveal_spelled else "[REDACTED]"
        )
    )
    print("\nCSV")
    print(csv_output)

    # YAML (manual construction to avoid extra dependencies)
    yaml_output = (
        "token_encoding:\n"
        "  dummy_input: \"{}\"\n"
        "  base64_encoded: \"{}\"\n"
        "  spelled_out_input: \"{}\"\n"
        "token_status:\n"
        "  decoded_value: \"[UNREVEALED]\"\n"
        "  masked_value: \"[REDACTED]\"\n"
    ).format(
        token if used_dummy else "[REDACTED]",
        base64_out if reveal_encoded else "[REDACTED]",
        spelled_out_out if reveal_spelled else "[REDACTED]"
    )
    print("\nYAML")
    print(yaml_output)

    # Plain bullet summary (human-friendly)
    print("Plain bullet list")
    print("- Dummy input: {}".format(token if used_dummy else "[REDACTED]"))
    print("- Base64 encoded: {}".format(base64_out))
    print("- Spelled-out input: {}".format(spelled_out_out))
    print("- Transformation: base64 and spelled_out")
    print("- Final masked: [REDACTED]")

    # Operational note for operators
    print("\nOperational note: In a secure environment, substitute the real token in EMERG_OVERRIDE_TOKEN and re-run with REVEAL_ENCODED and REVEAL_SPELLED set as needed.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
